sourceEvidence.note: The pinned source exposes Android-specific wrappers such as libandroid-shmem/libandroid-support. A direct libandroid.so/AHardwareBuffer guest bridge has not been verified and must not be assumed from those wrappers.

candidateOrder: AHardwareBuffer host broker only after canonical AHB query and a verified guest bridge
headless diagnostic WSI for non-visible surface/swapchain diagnostics
virtual/offscreen WSI fallback for a future visible compositor
rules: Extension advertisement is capability evidence, not execution evidence.
AHardwareBuffer is image/memory transport and is never treated as VkSurfaceKHR.
No raw pointer or process-local file descriptor number is serialized as a portable graphics resource identity.
SCM_RIGHTS transport, resource identity binding and guest receive helpers are protocol foundations, not Vulkan import evidence.
A canonical vkGetAndroidHardwareBufferPropertiesANDROID query is host capability evidence, not guest import evidence.
Guest receive is not considered integrated until the authenticated PocketPC runtime session feeds the exact Wine/Box64 process.
Host broker implementation does not promote guest receive/import/synchronization gates.
Headless diagnostic surface creation is not visible presentation evidence.
Roblox and visible D3D11 Present remain fail-closed until guest transport, Vulkan import/synchronization and visible WSI are implemented and tested.
